english translation text: O MUSLIMS IF ONLY YOU KNEW

arabic text: AY MUSLAMAAN KAASH SOCHA HOTA KAY MOHAMMED KA NAWASA HAI YEH
english translation text: O MUSLIMS IF ONLY YOU KNEW HE WAS THE GRANDSON OF THE PROPHER (SAW)

arabic text: HALAT-E-SAJDA MAIN HAI BAYKASO MAJBOOR BHI HAI\nAUR KAYI ROZ KA PYAASA HAI YEH
english translation text: IN THE STATE OF SAJDA HE IS OPPRESSED AND HELPLESS\nAND HE HAS BEEN THIRSTY FOR MANY DAYS

arabic text: BOLI ZAINAB ZULM SHABBIR PEH DHANAY WAALO PATHARON KAY TALAY MAYYAT KO CHUPANAY WAALO
english translation text: ZAINAB SAID OH YOU WHO ARE OPPRESSING SHABBIR AND YOU’RE HIDING HIS BODY UNDER STONES

arabic text: HAYE KAANDHAY PEH UTHATE THEY JINHAY KHATMAY RASOOL\nMERAY US BHAI KA LAASHA HAI YEH
english translation text: THE ONE WHO WAS CARRIED ON THE SHOULDERS OF THE\nPROPHET (SAW) THAT IS THE BODY OF MY BROTHER

arabic text: JIS KA GHAZI NA RAHA AUR ALI AKBAR NA BACHA BHAI KI LAASH PAY KHULKAY JISAY RONAY NA DIYA
english translation text: THE ONE WHO’S ABBAS HAS GONE AND ALI AKBAR TOO DID NOT OPENLY CRY ON HER BROTHER’S BODY

arabic text: AAJ MATAM SAR-E-BAZAAR JO HUM KARTAY HAY ISSI ZAINAB KA DILASA HAI YEH
english translation text: TODAY AS WE DO MATAM AROUND THE WORLD THIS IS THE CONDOLENCE WE GIVE TO BIBI ZAINAB

arabic text: SAYYEDON KA BHARA GHAR BAAR JALAYA KYU HAI BIBIYON KO SAR-E-BAZAAR PHIRAYA KYU HAI
english translation text: WHY HAVE YOU BURNT THE HOLY HOUSES? WHY ARE YOU PARADING THE LADIES IN THE BAZAAR?

arabic text: TUNAY TOH YEH BHI NA SOCHA KAY JO QAIDI HAY BANAY\nPAAK ZAHRA KA ASASA HAI YEH
english translation text: YOU DIDN’T EVEN THINK THAT THESE 'PRISONERS'...\nARE THE STRENGTH OF ZAHRA (S.A.)

arabic text: MAIN HUN ZAINAB MUJHE HAIDER KO SAMAJTA KYU HAIN SUN KAY KHUTBA MERA MAL’OON BIGARTA KYU HAI
english translation text: I AM ZAINAB WHY DO YOU THINK I AM HAIDAR? LISTENING TO MY KHUTBA WHY ARE YOU BECOMING AGGRESSIVE?

arabic text: BOLI ZAINAB KAY YEH KHUTBA HI NAHI SUN AY YAZID PAAK QURAN KA KHULASA HAI YEH
english translation text: 'LISTEN YAZID! THIS IS NOT JUST A KHUTBA' SAID BIBI ZAINAB THESE ARE THE WORDS OF THE HOLY QURAAN!

arabic text: SAANIY-E-ZAHRA KI AKHTAR YEH ATAA HAI TUJHKO\nNOHA LIKHNAY KE LIYE DARD MILA HAY TUJH KO
english translation text: YOU HAVE RECEIVED THIS GIFT FROM BIBI ZAINAB\nOH 'AKHTAR' TO WRITE NAWHAS WITH SUCH EMOTIONS

arabic text: TERAY ALFAZ MAI HAI FATIMA ZAHRA KI DUA TERA ANDAAZ JUDASA HAI YEH
english translation text: YOUR WORDS CONTAIN THE DUA OF BIBI FATEMA (S.A) YOUR WRITING IS UNIQUE
